name: aimux-cli
description: Local agent multiplexer for AI coding tools with native TUIs

scripts.dev:gui:web: aimux daemon ensure && yarn --cwd app dev:web:local
scripts.dev:gui:web:relay: aimux daemon ensure && yarn --cwd app dev:web:relay
scripts.dev:gui:native: aimux daemon ensure && yarn --cwd app dev:native:local
scripts.dev:gui:native:relay: aimux daemon ensure && yarn --cwd app dev:native:relay
scripts.dev:gui:ios: aimux daemon ensure && yarn --cwd app dev:ios:local
scripts.dev:gui:ios:relay: aimux daemon ensure && yarn --cwd app dev:ios:relay
scripts.dev:gui:android: aimux daemon ensure && yarn --cwd app dev:android:local
scripts.dev:gui:android:relay: aimux daemon ensure && yarn --cwd app dev:android:relay
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && yarn --cwd relay install --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd relay typecheck
scripts.audit:parser: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p aimux --test fixture_agent_contracts fixture_agent_output_parser
scripts.audit:parser:strict: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p aimux --test fixture_agent_contracts fixture_agent_output_parser && ./scripts/audit-fixture-enforcement.mjs --suite=fixture_agent_contracts --corpus=testdata/contracts/v1/agent-output/parser-adversarial.json
scripts.verify:fast: yarn verify:push && yarn lint && yarn native:fmt:check && yarn check:local-build-boundary && yarn audit:rust-orphans && yarn audit:parser:strict && yarn audit:async-blocking && yarn audit:async-seams && yarn audit:async-clippy && yarn audit:contract-secrets
scripts.verify:full: yarn verify:fast && yarn native:test && yarn test && yarn --cwd app lint --max-warnings=0 && yarn --cwd app test
scripts.verify:app: yarn --cwd app typecheck && yarn --cwd app lint --max-warnings=0 && yarn --cwd app test
scripts.native:clippy: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p aimux -- -D warnings
scripts.native:clippy:all-targets: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p aimux --all-targets -- -D warnings

author: Sam <sam@tealstreet.io>
